title: 第17章 外门大比报名第18章 备战
content_zh:
宗门的钟声响起时，顾渊正在后院挥剑。
不是一声，是九声。低沉而悠长的钟声从剑峰方向传来，一声接一声，像是某种古老的巨兽在苍穹之中低吟。
钟声穿透了清晨的薄雾，传遍了整个苍穹剑宗，从外门到内门，从杂役院到剑峰之巅。
顾渊收剑，抬头看向剑峰。
九声钟响。
宗门的大事。
朱八斗从食堂冲出来，围裙还系在腰上，手里拎着一把锅铲。
他的圆圆的脸上沾着面粉，眼睛瞪得老大，看向钟声传来的方向。
“九声钟？“他喃喃道。
“发生什么事了？“
陈牧也从住处走了出来，木剑扛在肩上，敦实的身影在晨雾中显得格外沉默。
他走到后院门口，和朱八斗站在一起，两个人同时看向顾渊。
顾渊没有说话。
他握着剑，站在原地，等待着。
杂役院的弟子们纷纷从茅草屋里涌出来，三三两两地聚在一起，议论纷纷。
有人揉着惺忪的睡眼，有人披着外衣，还有人拎着扫帚和木桶就冲了出来。
整个杂役院在短短几息之间就从沉睡中惊醒，像是被冷水浇透的蚁穴。
“九声钟？我没听错吧？“
“宗门出大事了？“
“该不会是有外敌入侵吧？“

“入侵个屁！九声钟是召集令，不是警报！“
很快，消息来了。
一个身穿靛青色弟子服的外门弟子从石阶上跑下来，一边跑一边喊，声音在安静的清晨里传得很远：
“三年一度的外门大比！一个月后举行！所有外门弟子均可报名！优胜者晋升内门！“
他的声音从杂役院门口飘过，没有停留，继续向山下跑去。
更多的喊声从远处传来，此起彼伏，像是一阵风吹过麦田，掀起层层波浪。
外门大比。
顾渊站在后院中，握着剑的手指微微收紧。
三天前，残魂说过——“外门大比之前“，印记觉醒就会完成。
他原以为大比还有很久，没想到就在一个月后。
“外门大比？“朱八斗挠了挠头，面粉从头发上落下来。
“那不是外门弟子的事吗？跟咱们杂役院有什么关系？“
陈牧说：“没有关系。“
他说的是事实。
外门大比，顾名思义，是外门弟子之间的竞争。
杂役院的弟子理论上也可以参加——“理论上“的意思是，从来没有人去过。
杂灵根和凡体，在外门天才面前连一招都撑不过。
杂役院的弟子们从各自的茅草屋里探出头来，议论纷纷。
有人好奇，有人羡慕，有人嗤笑。
但没有人动。

没有人说“我要去报名“。
因为他们都知道，那不是属于他们的舞台。
顾渊沉默了很久。
然后他收剑入鞘，转身向院外走去。
content_en:
When the sect's bell rang, Gu Yuan was wielding his sword in the backyard.
Not one sound, but nine. Low and long bells came from the direction of Jianfeng, one after another, like some ancient giant beast whispering in the sky.
The sound of the bell penetrated the early morning mist and spread throughout the entire Cang Qiong Sword Sect, from the outer gate to the inner gate, from the Servants' Courtyard to the top of Sword Peak.
Gu Yuan put away his sword and looked up at Jianfeng.
Nine bells ring.
A major event for the sect.
Zhu Badou rushed out of the canteen, with his apron still tied around his waist and a spatula in his hand.
His round face was stained with flour, and his eyes were wide open as he looked in the direction where the bell was coming from.
"Nine bells?" he murmured.
"What happened?"
Chen Mu also walked out of his residence, with his wooden sword on his shoulder. His stocky figure looked particularly silent in the morning mist.
He walked to the door of the backyard and stood with Zhu Badou. The two of them looked at Gu Yuan at the same time.
Gu Yuan said nothing.
He held the sword and stood there, waiting.
The disciples of the Servant Court poured out of the thatched huts one after another, gathered together in twos and threes, and talked about it.
Some people were rubbing their sleepy eyes, some were wearing coats, and some were rushing out carrying brooms and barrels.
The entire courtyard was awakened from a deep sleep in just a few breaths, like an ant nest soaked with cold water.
"Nine bells? Did I hear it correctly?"
"Something big happened to the sect?"
"Could it be that there is an invasion from a foreign enemy?"
"Invasion is a bullshit! The nine-ring bell is a summons, not an alarm!"
Soon, the news came.
An outer disciple wearing an indigo disciple uniform ran down the stone steps, shouting as he ran, and his voice spread far in the quiet morning:
"The triennial outer sect competition! It will be held in one month! All outer sect disciples can register! The winner will be promoted to the inner sect!"
His voice drifted past the door of the handyman's yard, and he continued running down the mountain without stopping.
More shouts came from the distance, one after another, like a gust of wind blowing through the wheat field, setting off layers of waves.
Great competition at the outer door.
Gu Yuan stood in the backyard, his fingers holding the sword slightly tightened.
Three days ago, Remnant Soul said - "Before the Outer Sect Competition", the awakening of the mark will be completed.
He originally thought that the competition would be a long time away, but he didn't expect that it would be just one month later.
"Outer competition?" Zhu Badou scratched his head, flour falling from his hair.
"Isn't that a matter for the outer disciples? What does it have to do with our Servant House?"
Chen Mu said: "It doesn't matter."
What he said is true.
The Outer Sect Competition, as the name suggests, is a competition between outer sect disciples.
Theoretically, disciples from the Miscellaneous Courtyard can also participate - "theoretically" means that no one has ever been there.
With mixed spiritual roots and mortal bodies, they can't even stand up to a single move in front of the outer sect genius.
The disciples in the Servant House poked their heads out of their thatched huts and started talking among themselves.
Some are curious, some are envious, and some are scoffing.
But no one moved.
No one said, "I'm going to sign up."
Because they all know that it is not their stage.
Gu Yuan was silent for a long time.
Then he sheathed his sword, turned around and walked out of the courtyard.
